address: Khalidiyah St, Al Khalidiyah, W8, Abu Dhabi
bio: The first thing you’ll notice at this bright, contemporary restaurant is a queue of people picking up their orders of manaqeesh and the fresh breads coming out of the oven. The extensive menu offers a range of flavoursome Middle Eastern dishes and it’s a popular destination for breakfast. The restaurant is right in the heart of Al Khalidiyah and is part of a group of family-owned establishments.
